_meta.description: Compact English lexicon used by the offline heuristic POS tagger (core/heuristic_nlp.py). Tags are spaCy Universal POS tags: NOUN, PROPN, VERB, ADJ, ADV, DET, PRON, ADP, CCONJ, SCONJ, AUX, NUM, PART, INTJ, X. When a real spaCy model (en_core_web_lg/sm) is installed its statistical tagger is used instead and this file is ignored. Unknown tokens fall back to morphological suffix rules, then to NOUN (correct for the majority of technical resume vocabulary).
